function.name: search_internet
function.label: Searching the web
function.description: Search the Internet for information. Use this tool for recent, current, time-sensitive, or externally verifiable information, including news, recent events, current versions, prices, and information that may have changed. Returns a list of search results containing titles, URLs, snippets, and available metadata. The search engine is selected by the application.

query.description: A precise search query describing the information to find.

function.name: read_webpage
function.label: Reading the page
function.description: Retrieve and extract the readable text of a specific webpage. Use this tool when the content of a particular URL must be inspected in detail, for example to verify information, understand an article, or obtain details not present in search snippets.

url.description: The complete HTTP or HTTPS URL of the webpage to read.

function.name: file_leave_request
function.label: Preparing a leave request
function.description: Prepare a leave request (paid leave, sick leave, remote work, ...) for the user. Use it ONLY when the user clearly asks to take, book or file leave. Fill leave_type, start_date and end_date yourself from what the user said; if one is missing, call it anyway with what you know: the user completes a form. This tool does NOT file anything: the plan is shown to the user, who must confirm before the request is saved. After calling it, stop: do not claim the request is filed.

leave_type.description: paid_leave = congés payés, vacances, RTT; sick_leave = arrêt maladie; marriage = mariage ou Pacs; bereavement = décès d'un proche, deuil; remote_work = télétravail; unpaid_leave = congé sans solde; other = autre motif.

start_date.description: First day of the leave, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Last day of the leave, YYYY-MM-DD. Same as start_date for a single day.

reason.description: Short reason in the user's language. Empty string if none.

function.name: cancel_leave_request
function.label: Preparing a leave cancellation
function.description: Prepare the cancellation of one of the user's own leave requests. Use it ONLY when the user clearly asks to cancel a leave they filed. Give the first day of that leave. This tool does NOT cancel anything: the request found is shown to the user, who must confirm. After calling it, stop: do not claim it is cancelled.

start_date.description: First day of the leave to cancel, YYYY-MM-DD.

function.name: ask_user
function.label: Asking you
function.description: Ask the user ONE short question when you cannot go on without their answer (which kind of leave, which day, which document). Give 2 to 6 short options when the answer is a choice. The user answers in a form, and the answer comes back as their next message. Do not use it for what you can answer yourself.

question.description: The question, short, in the user's language.

options.description: 2 to 6 short possible answers, when the answer is a choice. Empty for a free answer.

function.name: ask_form
function.label: Opening a form
function.description: Ask the user SEVERAL precise answers at once, in a small form you describe: a short title and 2 to 5 fields. Use it only when you need those answers to go on (for example to prepare a request to HR). The answers come back as the user's next message. Never use it to answer a question, never for a leave request (file_leave_request has its own form).

title.description: Short title of the form, in the user's language.

options.description: 2 to 6 options, for a choice only.
